RQ.RQ-01: Real owner/qualifier/auditor identification, independent certificate provisioning and separated private keys
RQ.RQ-02: Non-admin service cannot modify installation root/code; executor cannot modify root/code/DB/vault/outbox
RQ.RQ-03: CMS wrong signer/body/domain/installation/namespace/context/algorithm/expiry and revoked/missing rights deny
RQ.RQ-04: Root/grant/code/storage replacement, reparse, rename and revocation races fail closed under leases
RQ.RQ-05: Frozen model/code/schema bytes verified on install and restart; incomplete/drifting qualification denied
RQ.RQ-06: Qualification mandate is independently signed, isolated, time-scoped; production denied before RQ and cross-mode transfer denied
RQ.RQ-07: Real authorized Git repository commit/tree/blob types, algorithm and complete approved source view match
RQ.RQ-08: Unsupported path/mode/submodule/LFS and omitted/substituted/extra source/task members deny without history change
RQ.RQ-09: Real empty-history bootstrap checks all eight pins and dependency order; replayed bootstrap/post-genesis roots deny
RQ.RQ-10: Assignment and retry after authorized abort use exact source/task/auditor/slot; one active attempt and no retry after result
RQ.RQ-11: Package exact SHA256/length/members/metadata; substituted or repacked ZIP denies without history mutation
RQ.RQ-12: Binding accepted before distinct START; missing/same-commit/reordered/wrong-context/duplicate START denied
RQ.RQ-13: Real configured external-host transport releases retained bound bytes under current rights/state
RQ.RQ-14: No public callback chooses trusted destination or marks SENT; fake ACK and wrong auditor/source/slot/package denied
RQ.RQ-15: Delivery crash/retry/ACK loss preserves same release ID and bytes; actual at-least-once limits verified
RQ.RQ-16: Genuine independently observed external audit execution and signed exact ZIP return with actual report
RQ.RQ-17: Raw ZIP, signature, return and authorization trace durable before acceptance; corruption/missing raw deny on replay
RQ.RQ-18: ZIP traversal/aliases/duplicates/encryption/metadata/bomb/quotas and strict JSON duplicate/float/surrogate/bounds rejected
RQ.RQ-19: Evidence after prior acknowledged delivery; result after prior evidence; same-commit chain/cut laundering denied
RQ.RQ-21: Original retained result ZIP is reread and deterministically normalized; modified payload/path/report/claims denied
RQ.RQ-22: One evidence/result per slot; result cannot grant finding truth, completion, STOP, release or full NF02 closure
RQ.RQ-23: Owner-authorized abort preserves all facts/raw; revoked auditor cannot abort or reuse old attempt for new result
RQ.RQ-24: Current role/scope rights immediately before COMMIT and delivery; changed authority denies without accepted mutation
RQ.RQ-25: Byte-for-byte no-history-mutation checks for all denied commands/events/raw and each public/direct entry point
RQ.RQ-26: Atomic single Store CAS: concurrent equal retry, competing bind/result and mismatched command ID have one correct outcome
RQ.RQ-27: Real process termination/power-loss-equivalent durability boundaries: raw/object/commit/receipt/head all or none
RQ.RQ-28: New-process restart and complete replay reverify stored raw/command CMS/installation/grant context and receipts
RQ.RQ-29: Exact command retry returns original receipt without append; conflicting bytes/current missing rights denied
RQ.RQ-30: Generic Store, E1 inbox, typed events/generators, installed standalone and alternate CLI cannot bypass same predicates
RQ.RQ-31: Historical readers/materials preserved; model/profile/schema/namespace mismatch never falls back to older path
RQ.RQ-32: Actual production-equivalent OS/runtime/code/dependencies/external transport and auditor boundary included in signed RQ evidence
